items.material_issue: Narrative facts, quantities and causality are preserved: stralite/蓝锆石, twenty-fold/二十倍, thirty times/30倍, octogenarian/年逾八旬, the dwarves' manipulation, the halfling withdrawal and the pouch demonstration all match.
items.evidence: "increased twenty-fold"→"提高到原来的二十倍"; "thirty times the previous amount"→"以30倍的价钱"; "stralite, ground to dust... made unusable and worthless"→"磨成粉并掺杂了杂质和其他金属的蓝锆石——这种蓝锆石无法使用且毫无价值". Minor rewordings ("peace"→"胜利", added "正为威慑他们") do not alter the events; context confirms this is the lore entry southspar-note-1.

items.material_issue: "yeeks" is rendered as "夺心魔", a term conventionally denoting mind flayers/illithids rather than yeeks; whether this is the established in-game glossary term for the yeek race cannot be determined from the supplied evidence. All other content (dates, subject letters, outcomes) matches.
items.evidence: "I'll be glad to get rid of these disgusting yeeks... their oversized heads"→"能摆脱这些令人作呕的夺心魔…他们那大得过分的脑袋"; the adjacent lore in context ("plenty more dumb yeeks available") is English-only, so no Chinese term for "yeek" is available to confirm consistency. Test-log lines are accurate: "Imploded"→"体内发生爆裂", "Half transitioned, half remained"→"一半传送走了，一半留在原地".
